quest.title: Good Sign
quest.description: Zhihua firmly believes that he will soon meet his soulmate, and he's looking for someone to help him find her...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: "True love may be impossibly far away, or it may be right under your nose. You cannot force it. But when its day comes, it will reveal itself to you right before your very eyes..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Why, it's my fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: This is what Qiming the fortune-teller advised me regarding my love life: it may be impossibly far away, or it may be right under my nose...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I daresay she must be hinting at something... But whatever could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I have heard storytellers say that you can tell when your fortune is about to come true, because signs appear all around you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: And I have a strong sense that true love is on its way!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Could you examine the surrounding area for me and check for signs?

response.speaker: Zhihua
response.text: You know the saying, "Lookers-on see most of the game"? Well, were I to look for signs myself...

response.speaker: Zhihua
response.text: ...I fear that I would interpret anything and everything I saw as a sign that true love is on its way.

response.speaker: Zhihua
response.text: That's why I need your help!

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: The toys are really selling well today! I hope they make the children happy...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Have you found a sign?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A couple of birds on the roof.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I see... Splendid! This is a good sign!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Two pigeons who both forsake their own flocks to be together... All they care about is each other as they soar off, wing to wing, into the horizon...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: This sign can only mean one thing: I shall soon meet the one who loves me, and me alone!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: ...And she will fight against the odds, tear down all obstacles to break free from those that would seek to deter her; then, finally, we shall be together and it will be us against the world...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Ahem! I, uh... Thank you, thank you... I should of course check this with Qiming...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A merchant doing well today.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Business is booming? Wealth is rolling in? Not bad... It sounds promising...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: One reaps what one sows. Patience and dedication always pay off in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: ...Love is the same way! My goodness, it is so clear to me now! One must invest in one's love life with patience and diligence; then and only then shall it surely flourish...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: ...Ahem! Th—Thanks for, uh, that. I must of course give this some careful thought; who knows what it could mean for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Oh, Qiming! One day, the day will come...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dead leaves...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? Even Paimon knows that dead leaves and love have nothing in common!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: On the contrary... they are intimately related!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: You may look at these dead leaves and dismiss them as withered and lost... But I see potential. Boundless potential.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: All it takes is one tiny spark to turn them into a roaring fire, and the slightest gust of wind can send them soaring majestically up into the sky!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: An apt analogy for my unrequited love... Stored up in my heart all this time... Always hoping for something, something that will change everything...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alas, such things are for fate to decide. Who knows when the turning point will come, and how it will happen...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I should not lose heart. Everything happens for a reason, I just need to have patience.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Oh, and uh... Thanks. Heh.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A cat and a fish made friends.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: My goodness, what a wondrous sign. You clearly knew what to look for.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Such a triumphant friendship... Both the cat and the fish are truly admirable...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Is this not precisely the meaning of love!? Truly, the power of love transcends all boundaries!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I, for one, have nothing but the utmost respect for both of them.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Clearly, this sign is telling me... Fear no obstacle in the pursuit of love; only then will Qiming see...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, thanks! Thanks a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A pack of dogs.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Oh no... What portent of doom is this? Is my love life to end before it begins?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what? Those doggies looked like the best of friends...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I know that group of dogs. They are indeed friendly to one another, and they stick together all year round.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: That might sound like a good thing, but the fact is... None of those dogs has ever found a mate.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Sooner or later they'll grow old, and then it'll be too late...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Is this sign really trying to tell me to while away the time until I die with my buddies, because I will never find a partner!?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I—I need to have a seat... and a long, hard think...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A couple of birds on the roof.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I see... Splendid! This is a good sign!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Two pigeons who both forsake their own flocks to be together... All they care about is each other as they soar off, wing to wing, into the horizon...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: This sign can only mean one thing: I shall soon meet the one who loves me, and me alone!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: ...And she will fight against the odds, tear down all obstacles to break free from those that would seek to deter her; then, finally, we shall be together and it will be us against the world...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Ahem! I, uh... Thank you, thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I wonder what twist of fate led them to meet... to understand one another... and to experience true love together...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: *sigh* Oh, what a pity that I am not a dove... I shall never know the sweet taste of another dove's love upon my beak... Oh, what a cruel fate!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you settle for the taste of dove itself?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: The taste of dove? What are you... No, you didn't... Surely you didn't...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: What did you do!? It was a metaphor, you buffoon! A metaphor! You don't seriously think I was talking about physically eating the abstract concept of romantic love!?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I know some people are naturally unromantic, but you just took it to a whole other level! And my goodness, how will this impact my fortune...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I just... Never mind, forget it. I need some time alone to calm down. Why don't you just get back to whatever it was you were doing today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dead leaves...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? Even Paimon knows that dead leaves and love have nothing in common!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: On the contrary... they are intimately related!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: You may look at these dead leaves and dismiss them as withered and lost... But I see potential. Boundless potential.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: All it takes is one tiny spark to turn them into a roaring fire, and the slightest gust of wind can send them soaring majestically up into the sky!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: An apt analogy for my unrequited love... Stored up in my heart all this time... Always hoping for something, something that will change everything...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alas, such things are for fate to decide. Who knows when the turning point will come, and how it will happen...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I should not lose heart. Everything happens for a reason, I just need to have patience.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Analogies aside, I was the turning point for those leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: ...Excuse me? What on earth do you mean by that?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Wait, you don't mean... Surely you didn't... Please don't tell me you...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Oh no... That's it, it's all over! If you disrupt the natural timing of the turning point... it ruins everything! Fate and love will be plunged into chaos!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Who do you think you are, playing god with the fate of these leaves!? Maybe you were trying to help, but I assure you, you have done more harm than you can possibly imagine!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: What am I going to do... Ugh, get out of here, go and ruin someone else's life! I need some time to cool down...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A cat and a fish made friends.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: My goodness, what a wondrous sign. You clearly knew what to look for.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Such a triumphant friendship... Both the cat and the fish are truly admirable...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Is this not precisely the meaning of love!? Truly, the power of love transcends all boundaries!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I, for one, have nothing but the utmost respect for both of them.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: But especially for the fish. It knew full well that the object of its affection was a cat, yet still it chose to bare its soul and express its true feelings unreservedly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm glad you got to pay your respects.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: What do you mean? ...Oh. The fish is right here... You brought it with you!?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: So you just kidnapped this poor fish while its helpless feline friend watched in horror?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: What kind of person witnesses an incredibly rare case of inter-species friendship... and then bursts in to tear them apart!? You're supposed to protect things like that, you moron!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: And all that aside — this would've been the perfect sign, but you just had to ruin it, didn't you!

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Ugh. Please, I'm begging you, just leave me alone. I need some time to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A pack of dogs.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Oh no... What portent of doom is this? Is my love life to end before it begins?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what? Those doggies looked like the best of friends...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: I know that group of dogs. They are indeed friendly to one another, and they stick together all year round.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: That might sound like a good thing, but the fact is... None of those dogs has ever found a mate.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: And because they are surrounded by friends all the time, they just aren't bothered by it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They might have an incentive to find partners now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: An incentive? Er... Wait, did you chase them around and break up the group?

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Huh... You know, that could actually work...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Sometimes it can take an external force to free you from the web of your own making... freeing you to pursue true love...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Brilliant! I can't thank you enough. It is clear to me now what this sign means.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Qiming... I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Did you find anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's all for now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Okay... I suppose I should get some more input from Qiming...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Love will find me... No matter what, it will happen...

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Did you find anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's all for now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhihua
dialogues.text: Okay... I suppose I should get some more input from Qiming...
